resources.string: Review listening history, saved moments and lyric timing across your paired devices.
Each sync includes up to 1,000 recent listens, 500 saved moments and 500 lyric offsets. Unmatched songs are reported.
History is merged without removing existing listens. At the same saved point, notes and lyric offsets use the selected source. Audio files and lyric documents are not transferred.
Personal state was not fully applied. Some changes may have completed. Refresh the preview before retrying.
Replaces the phone queue with this matched song at the current PC position. Requires an available matching version on the phone.

PC segments retain their end position. A PC that supports only segments skips phone point bookmarks; notes over 100 characters cannot be imported on the phone. Skipped bookmarks are reported and kept on their source.
Bookmarks kept on the source because the destination does not support their form: %1$d
